title: Making Decisions: if, elif and else

ai_pair_moment.flaw: The rule is a free biscuit for 15 or more. The AI wrote if to_pay > 15: and predicted 'Reward: a free biscuit' for exactly 15.0. The program prints 'No biscuit this time', because > excludes the boundary value. >= fixes it.

changes: Chained comparisons (8 <= hour < 18) and nested if blocks are left out to keep one new idea per step; the practice uses and, and puts divisions inside else.
Added the AI skill's key term, edge case, together with boundary value, because the curriculum's AI skill is asking AI for edge cases.
The AI section adds two video-only files, ai_biscuit_mine.py (the Write stage) and ai_biscuit_typo.py (the Debug stage), both verified like the other examples.
outstanding_issues: The error reports in Common mistakes show the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path to the file appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
